facts.fact: The UNDP outcome evaluation mission, visiting PRM stations and commands in September 2007, verified the almost complete absence of digital records of autos, case files or any other procedure across the PRM.

The evaluation mission found in September 2007 that IT use was mainly confined to the Central Command, limited in provincial commands and non-existent at district and police station level, with piles of paper serving as case file archives and stations lacking paper and typewriter ribbons.

The evaluation mission reported in September 2007 that IT use was non-existent at district and police station level, and that most stations it visited had either a non-functional computer or outdated typewriters; it gives no count of stations.

The evaluation states that the Phase III output of an information technology plan for the PRM had not been achieved at all by October 2007, its needs assessment waiting on a bilateral funding agreement with Spain.
